title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Auditorium on 1984-12-28
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/48k) > Adobe Audition CC2015 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/
source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel (Technics) > Dat (Panasonic SV-3800/48k)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a sweet, crowd‑charged show highlighted by a transcendent Space > The Other One and a stellar China > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: This upgraded soundboard recording showcases an energetic audience and strong second‑half performance, with standout moments like the soulful Rain, the seamless Spoonful into the drums, and a transcendent Space > The Other One. While the first set is described as a bit lackluster, the overall vibe is upbeat and the band shines through to the end.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review praises both the musical performance (especially second set) and the upgraded soundboard quality, yielding a solid rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a "great upgrade" indicating clear, improved audio; no specific flaws mentioned.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as lackluster, but the second half and encore deliver strong energy and seamless transitions, with the crowd’s excitement shining through.

band_member_comments.Drums: Healy (Mickey Hart) works hard and drives the drum sections, especially during Spoonful into the drums.
